Definition: from G4253 and G2875; to drive forward (as if by beating), i.e. (figuratively and intransitively) to advance (in amount, to grow; in time, to be well along):--increase, proceed, profit, be far spent, wax.
BiblicalUsage: Prokopto means to drive forward, to advance, to make progress. Luke says Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and Paul says the night is far spent and the day is at hand.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe growing in wisdom is the pattern Jesus himself set, and the far-spent night means the day is nearer than I think.
